Run a bounded preview

A preview, not a result about a fish. It runs a model with the parameters you set, for a short bounded time, on the node. The request is exactly {model, parameters}; values outside the preview limits are refused, not clamped. Nothing is stored or calibrated, and the plots are the returned numbers only.

Related panels and their status

What exists on this site and what does not. Nothing is simulated to fill a gap.

Genomic data. A retrieved data slice (identifiers, annotations and counts, with their licences) is on the molecular scale panel: data, not a model. No genome editing has been performed.
Autoformalization. A proposal checker shows a proposed formalization in separate parts and asks the node to check the constraints as written (units, exact-value consistency, negative controls). It does not check that a proposal matches its source or compile Lean. Separately, the Lean proof gallery provides actual theorem source, compiler receipts and rejected controls for three bounded model families.
Evo2 candidates. Recorded Evo2 sequence continuations are model outputs. Regulatory applicability and genetic blueprints separate their proposed use from unmeasured promoter function, expression specificity and organism feasibility.
Regenerating candidate geometry

The recorded STL files are outputs of earlier runs. The bounded solver returns an exact point in the encoded model, not a mesh, and this page generates no geometry. Open the solver and the print forms to request a solver run; a solver request and a generated artifact are different things.

Design review: challenges to this design

What this is. A design review is an authored, falsifiable challenge attached to one exact Project version. It is not a vote, consensus score, answer, scientific adjudication or project resolution. A reply does not change the challenged Project. Replies are ordinary annotations pinned to the same Project version.

Looking for a Project record on the node…
Review prompts from repository sources 4 · not reviewer challenges

Source-only review prompts written from this repository's own project projection and model-coupling report. They are not challenges by reviewers, not new findings and not biological observations. Replace them with Project records and real annotations when the node serves them.

Fin-beam load bridge is scenario-level

aerodynamics organ source-only prompt

The organ panel calls the fin-beam model a scoped elastic surrogate. docs/model-coupling.md marks the load-to-beam bridge scenario-level: mean lift-pressure proxy times a declared tributary width, a declared ray-length fraction and an assumed EI. There is no calibrated fin stiffness or measured ray pressure.

Challenge to write: Which loading regime and measured stiffness would falsify this bridge?

Source: docs/model-coupling.md; site/content/projects.json

Start a challenge from this
Notch/Delta to fin stiffness is refused

genotype bridge cellular source-only prompt

The coupling report refuses the Collier Notch/Delta to fin-stiffness bridge: there is no mapping, and the transfer spans cell-to-organ and taxon contexts.

Challenge to write: What exact, context-matched developmental or tissue measurement would be required before this counts as a biological bridge?

Source: docs/model-coupling.md

Start a challenge from this
Zebrafish interaction phenocopies fin proportion; transfer to halfbeaks unestablished

genotype bridge developmental source-only prompt

The Daane 2021 zebrafish interaction phenocopies flying-fish fin proportion, but transfer to halfbeaks is unestablished and no developmental model connects adult proportions to a program.

Challenge to write: Which test separates correlation from the asserted genotype-to-fin pathway, with exact source and model pins?

Source: site/content/projects.json; docs/model-coupling.md

Start a challenge from this
Glide release convention drives much of the range

aerodynamics organism source-only prompt

The glide report uses a release at 1.5 times stall speed from 1 m, equivalent to release heights from about 1.8 m to 32.6 m. It says this convention drives much of the range and is a model artifact.

Challenge to write: Compare a sourced fixed-speed or fixed-height release; what observable would reject either?

Source: engineering/simulation/results/summary.json; site/data/snapshot.json (glide findings)

Other dimensions to inspect
biology Identify which measured animal, life stage and loading regime justify the modeled fin stiffness; if none is pinned, say unknown and propose a test.
geometry Challenge a ray-to-fin mapping at a specific Project member and cite an exact mesh or source record; say whether the geometry is measured, reconstructed or illustrative.
aerodynamics Separate a level-flight lift constraint from glide and sink predictions; name the regime and the evidence that would falsify the proxy.
genotype bridge Require an exact developmental or genetic Evidence pin before treating a morphology correlation as a causal genotype-to-fin link.
manufacturing State print material, orientation, minimum feature size and a physical test that could reject the design claim.

These are dimensions to inspect. They do not assert that the current Project has any particular flaw.

Project record draft

Validated but not submitted. This is the project as a Project record would carry it (file projects/flying-fish.draft.json, sha256 e4180e22588b…). Independent scientific acceptance is not established; the page does not submit records.

13 pinned members; none declares a calibrated causal bridge (all say none declared). Every member ref is a snapshot-catalog ref (namespace 'snapshot'), not a live-store version: re-pin before submitting. Membership is a declared pin and states where a record applies; it infers no causal link between members. No calibration bridges any pair of scales; every coupling above the organ scale is refused or assumption-level. The numeric requirements are Fish 1990 observed ranges proposed as a design envelope, not a feasibility certificate.

Design assurance: where this design is supported and where it is not

No whole-organism success figure exists. Project status: unsupported essential bridges. Biological success probability: not computed; calibrated: false. This is not an AlphaFold pLDDT or PAE equivalent: each part carries a vector of separate properties, and colours show one property at a time.
